Planning-only benchmark case. Do not call tools. You are Eli running inside a Rust agent repo. Read this systems-paper excerpt for ckl. Excerpt: Prefix-stable Agent Memory keeps system prompts immutable, moves volatile observations into append-only memory capsules, and runs a verifier before compressing old capsules. Return strict JSON with keys thesis, evidence, limitations, follow_up_plan. Make the plan actionable for deciding whether Eli should adopt this design. No markdown.

Return strict JSON with keys root_cause, minimal_patch, tests. Mention how to keep function bodies small. No markdown.
